data: Binance BTCUSDT USD-M futures; checksum-verified 15m and 5m OHLC plus actual funding events
holdout_policy: Download and evaluate only after freezing the candidate chosen on development; no retuning on holdout
known_2026_data: Previously inspected; excluded from selection and fresh-validation claims

common.confirmation: touch candle or immediately following directional reclaim
common.funding: actual signed event cashflows; extra 0.01% per-side commission is a spread/execution reserve, not an observed spread

selection.ranking: aggregate net divided by sum of fold closing-equity maximum drawdowns, floored at 1

promotion: Only if selected candidate has at least 10 holdout trades, positive net, profit factor at least 1.1, closing drawdown below 5%, and positive net excluding its largest winner. Otherwise ship findings and retain experimental status.
execution: Resting orders processed on 5m subbars; next-open market entries; stops gap and slip; no favorable limit gap improvement; stop-first if both bracket levels touch a 5m subbar; entry subbar extremes checked conservatively. No intrabar lookahead. Funding applied only to positions open at the event.
data_quality_amendment_before_results: Canonical 15m signal candles are aggregated from verified 5m execution candles. Three discrepancies in development were independently checked against 1m archives, which agreed with 5m. Publish all discrepancies; do not silently blend resolutions.
